scenarios.title: Publish an Epic with PBIs and run one PBI to a ready pull request with a PAT login

live.reason: not run in the #307 acceptance; no authorized disposable Azure DevOps project, and az is not installed on the development host

deterministic.reason: scripted az only; the implementation turn and the Gate are not driven on this route: the journey records the implementation stage through the store, and review feedback and readiness run through the real client, not a coordinator pass

gaps.summary: The extension route cannot read the signed-in identity, so doctor reports identity and permissions as skipped, status comments match by marker only, and pull-request clarification comments fail closed.
Work-item descriptions are created as escaped HTML that shows the approved Markdown text; az boards work-item create cannot set the Markdown format.

gaps.summary: A plan node selects another repository only through target_repository in the stored or draft plan JSON; the plan editor has no control and the planning role gets no guidance for it.
